description: This PHP source file defines a SelfEvaluationController class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class manages self-evaluation functionality related to performance reviews, including preparing data for rendering views and access control based on user roles. It extends AdminEvaluationController and uses traits for performance review services and user role management.

classes.name: SelfEvaluationController
classes.description: Controller handling self-evaluation features within the HRM system, including permission checks and view preparation.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the self-evaluation component for rendering based on the request's 'id' attribute, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the capability to perform self-evaluation on the specified review, throwing an exception if the review is invalid or employee is purged.
